info.name: Taf EMS API
info.description:
API requests for the Taf EMS backend.

1. Select the "Taf EMS - Local" environment.
2. Run the folders from top to bottom (or use Run collection). Login requests save the token automatically.

The collection can be run again and again: anything it changes, it changes back.

exec: pm.test('No month of a plan year', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.items.filter((p) => p.name.includes(' · '))).to.have.length(0));
pm.test('ACTIVE, and the year is OPEN', () => { pm.expect(p.status).to.eql('ACTIVE'); pm.expect(p.periods.status).to.eql('OPEN'); });
pm.test('Its months have not started yet, so they stay UPCOMING', () => pm.expect(p.periods.children[0].children[0].children[0].status).to.eql('UPCOMING'));

pm.test('Every period is CLOSED', () => { const p = pm.response.json().data.planYear; const all = [p.periods, ...p.periods.children, ...p.periods.children.flatMap((h) => h.children), ...p.periods.children.flatMap((h) => h.children).flatMap((q) => q.children)]; pm.expect(all.length).to.eql(19); all.forEach((x) => pm.expect(x.status).to.eql('CLOSED')); });
